entities.summary: Villa Garzoni at Collodi is a villa in Pescia, province of Pistoia,. The garden was built shortly before 1652 by the Garzoni family, relating to the site of the old castle, which stands slightly apart, closely associated with the village that nestles round it, on the edge of a clifflike slope, which had been chosen in earlier times for its defensible approach. Villa Garzoni is a museum in Europe, established in 1600. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
